general.notes: Reach is specified in meters (100m OM4, 70m OM3, 40m OM4, 30m OM3, 50m OM3) not km. Rx sensitivity values are Unstressed Receiver OMA Sensitivity at 25.78 Gb/s (-5.2 dBm), 10.3 Gb/s dual-rate rows (-7.5 dBm, -10.1 dBm). Average Receiver Power RxMAX min -10.3 dBm at 25.78 Gb/s is informative only per note 2. Total power dissipation may exceed 1 W during link establishment at case temperature below 25°C per electrical note 1. FTLF8538P5BCL single rate 25GbE only; FTLF8538P5BCV dual rate 25GbE and 10GbE. Regulatory text references II-VI Incorporated; product branded Finisar; copyright Coherent Corp. 2023.
